outcomes.Observable standard: Can state what is known, inferred, assumed, uncertain, value-laden, and AI-supplied; can find and evaluate primary evidence.
Can translate a real problem into quantities, scales, units, probabilities, models, and uncertainty.
Can design discriminating observations/experiments and connect evidence to mechanism without overclaiming.
Can reason algorithmically, automate work, understand software/network failure, and audit computational outputs.
Can design within constraints, trade off performance/cost/safety/maintainability, and learn from failure.
Can distinguish conceptual, empirical, logical, and normative disputes; reason about values, rights, meaning, mind, knowledge, and technology.
Can model incentives, power, markets, law, organizations, culture, history, demography, conflict, and institutional change.
Can place institutions, technologies, ideas, and identities in temporal sequences and recognize path dependence and contingency.
Can read difficult texts, write clearly, speak persuasively, listen closely, revise, and adapt to audience/medium.
Can draw, diagram, map, visualize data, prototype interfaces/objects, and critique aesthetic-functional form.
Can acquire a new domain, build durable memory, practice intelligently, calibrate confidence, and teach others.
Can specify, delegate, permission, evaluate, red-team, monitor, roll back, and defend AI-assisted work.
Can manage basic health, money, household systems, safety, digital security, logistics, maintenance, and emergencies.
Can listen, set boundaries, negotiate, repair conflict, care for others, collaborate, and sustain trust.
Understands institutions, rights, rules, public finance, media, collective action, power, and participation.
Can reason about tradeoffs, prices, work, firms, contracts, credit, insurance, investment, taxes, and long-run resource choices.
Can access valid health information, make risk-aware decisions, practice health-enhancing routines, and know when professional care is needed.
Can encounter art, literature, music, architecture, religion, and traditions with historical context and discriminate quality without mistaking preference for proof.
Can create goals, roles, decision rights, feedback, dissent, accountability, and learning processes for a team or institution.

outcomes.Observable standard: Can reason about low-probability/high-impact risks, environmental constraints, intergenerational effects, reversibility, and option value.
